name: Djerba
tagline: Island of white villages, street art and old faiths
summary: Djerba is a flat island of olive groves, white-domed mosques and sandy beaches off southern Tunisia. Visit the ancient El Ghriba synagogue, see hundreds of murals in the village of Erriadh (Djerbahood), browse the souks of Houmt Souk, and travel to the cave houses of Matmata and the Star Wars sets on the mainland.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal; summer is hot and busy.
arrival: Djerba-Zarzis airport has flights from Tunis and Europe.
gettingAround: Taxis, rental car or bikes; ferry or causeway to the mainland.
cashTip: Carry dinars (they cannot be taken out of the country); cards work in hotels. Tip about 10 percent.
foodTip: Couscous with fish, brik, Djerbian rice and grilled seafood.
buyTip: Pottery from Guellala and woven rugs.
baseArea: Houmt Souk or the east-coast beaches
